services.name: Skydive Wissota
services.desc: Welcomes Experienced Jumpers - you will always have people to jump with. We are a club focused on relative work and raising new skydivers, but all disciplines and experience levels are welcome to fly with us. You are welcome to camp at the dropzone or check out local hotels/lodging and restaurants by clicking here. Grill, microwave, and a pizza oven are available in the club, plus there is a huge fire pit on-site and you are welcome to stay after the jumping has stopped and hang out with us! Camping on-site with pull-out couches! © 2026 by ISPC Parachute Club / Skydive Wissota / Skydive Wisconsin / Skydive

explain.meaning: The part of a skydive before the parachute opens.
A first-jump method where a cord opens your parachute as you leave the plane.

blurb: Skydive Wissota offers skydiving experiences with stunning views of Lake Wissota and surrounding landscapes. They provide Tandem jumps and Static Line courses for first-time and experienced jumpers. Safety is emphasized with automatic activation devices, high-performance parachutes, and ground-to-air radios.
extraNote: Walk-ins only if schedule allows for Tandem jumps
